hub_name.description: Name of the hub. Maximum 50 characters. Cannot contain / , \ , or .

access_type.description: Hub access setting. HUB_ACCESS_PUBLIC or HUB_ACCESS_RESTRICTED.

description.description: Description of the hub. Maximum 1,000 characters, excluding HTML tags.

user_id.description: ID of the user performing the operation. Must have the HUB_MANAGEMENT permission.
